newsitem.title: CANADA: RTRS-Canada to fight Australia's salmon ban at WTO.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Canada to fight Australia's salmon ban at WTO.

text.p: Canada will proceed with plans to take Australia to the World Trade Organization over Australia's ban on imports of uncooked salmon, a government official said on Wednesday.
"At this point we are going forward with our request," Sanjeev Chowdhury, a spokesman for the Department of International Trade, said in a phone interview.

Canada threatened earlier this month to request a dispute settlement panel on March 20. There had since been no talks between the two countries, so Canada would go ahead with its request, Chowdhury said.
"Australia has the right to block the first request, but it (the dispute panel) becomes mandatory the second time around," he added.
He said Canada would request a panel again on April 30 if Australia blocked Canada's attempt on Thursday.
The Australia-Canada dispute had simmered for about 20 years, Canadian officials said.
In 1975, Australia introduced a quarantine measure banning the import of fresh salmon products, requiring all imported salmon to be either heat-treated or canned.
Australia said scientific analysis showed uncooked salmon contained at least 20 diseases that raised the country's concern. Canberra planned to defend its ban.
